topicName: Explain the difference between eager and lazy loading in JPA. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the difference between eager and lazy loading in JPA. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Eager and lazy loading are strategies for fetching related entities in JPA. Eager loading fetches related entities immediately, while lazy loading fetches them only when explicitly accessed."}]
